task.title: Full mobile responsive layout rework
task.description: Replace the single mobile media query with a comprehensive mobile layout. At max-width 768px: (1) Sidebar becomes a fixed bottom nav bar: #appView{flex-direction:column} .sidebar{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;width:100%;height:56px;flex-direction:row;z-index:500;padding:0;} nav{display:flex;flex-direction:row;padding:0;} .nav-item{flex:1;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 2px;font-size:10px;border-left:none;border-top:3px solid transparent;} .nav-item.active{border-top-color:var(--green-mid);border-left:none;} Add emoji icons before each nav item text: Dashboard=🏠, Contacts=👥, Queue=📤, Drafts=📝, Batch=⚡, Integrations=🔗, Activity=📊, Settings=⚙. Each nav item shows icon on top, label below. Hide .sidebar-logo and .sidebar-footer on mobile. (2) Add a fixed top header on mobile: create div id=mobileHeader style=position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:52px;background:var(--sidebar);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;justify-content:space-between;z-index:500 showing Renzo logo left, sidebar-user text center, logout button right as icon. Show mobileHeader only on mobile, hide on desktop. (3) Main content: .main{padding-top:52px;padding-bottom:64px} .view{padding:16px} (4) Contacts table on mobile: hide the table, show cards instead. In renderContacts() detect window.innerWidth<=768 and render card layout instead of table rows. Each card: background white, border-radius 12px, padding 16px, margin-bottom 10px, showing name+priority badge, company, tier badge, status badge, and Message button. (5) Modals on mobile: .modal-overlay{align-items:flex-end;} .modal-box{border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;max-height:90vh;margin:0;width:100%;} (6) Stat grid: 2 columns on mobile. (7) All touch targets minimum 44px height.
task.project_vision: Frontend-only AI outreach SaaS. Single HTML file. localStorage. Mobile must work as a first-class experience.

missing: Bottom navigation bar mobile styles (fixed bottom, horizontal layout, 56px height, z-index 500)
Mobile contact cards rendering (card-based layout with border-radius 12px, padding 16px)
Mobile modal bottom-sheet styles (aligned to viewport bottom, rounded top corners)
Window resize event listener for layout switching
Emoji icons injection into navigation items
Logout button as ⚙️ icon in mobile header
Username display in mobile header from sidebar-user data
Show/hide logic for mobileHeader based on viewport
data.note: The provided code only contains basic CSS styling and HTML structure. None of the mobile-responsive JavaScript functions (detectMobile, renderMobileContacts, createMobileHeader, initMobileLayout, addEmojiToNavItems, updateContactsView) are implemented. The mobile header element, bottom navigation transformation, card-based contact layout, and responsive breakpoint behavior are completely missing. This appears to be an incomplete desktop-only base template without any of the required mobile responsive features.

blocking_issues: Mobile navigation is completely inaccessible - sidebar is hidden on mobile but no hamburger menu or navigation alternative is implemented. Users cannot navigate between views on mobile devices.
Mobile header (#mobileHeader) is set to display:none but lacks responsive breakpoint to show it on small screens, making mobile completely non-functional.
No accessible labels for icon-only buttons (modal close button, mobile logout button) - screen readers cannot interpret '×' or icon buttons without aria-labels.
No email validation on ctEmail field - users can save contacts with invalid emails, then attempt to send, causing failures. Must validate email format before save or at send time.
generateMsg function references removed from chunk - cannot verify if API errors (network, auth, rate limit) are handled or displayed to user. If unhandled, users face silent failures.
No loading state management visible - if generateMsg is called while already loading, could trigger duplicate API calls and race conditions.
AI Guide modal has no mobile responsiveness - fixed width 340px will overflow on small screens (<375px)
Storage warning banner has no close button keyboard accessibility - onclick handler only, no keyboard trap management
Mobile navigation menu not implemented - users on mobile cannot access navigation items (sidebar is desktop-only, no hamburger menu or mobile nav visible)
Touch target size inadequate - .mobile-logout button has min-height:44px but nav items and many buttons don't meet 44x44px minimum for mobile accessibility
Duplicate #mobileHeader definition in CSS (lines appear twice) causing potential style conflicts
